en.title: Global Macro — fiscal protection narrows as energy and debt pressures converge before Bangkok
en.deck: A new UNDP assessment quantifies rising fuel costs, potential poverty exposure and shrinking fiscal room before the IMF–World Bank meetings in Bangkok.
